about.title: About Me
about.p1: Hi, I'm Danylo, a 17-year-old Software Engineering student in my 3rd year.
about.p2: Started with HTML/CSS, fell in love with JavaScript, React & Next.js, and now building full-stack applications with modern tools.
about.p3: Fast learner, problem-solver, and creative coder who enjoys turning ideas into polished digital products.
about.p4: Programming for me is more than code — it's creativity, continuous growth, and the joy of solving real problems.
